key.name: theme
key.description: The look of the taskbar, title bars and window buttons, chosen in Patrone Settings: "patrone" (Patrone's own), "modern" (flat and round), "classic" (plain and square, solid title bars), "royal" (glossy royal blue, a green Start button) or "studio" (translucent, round colored window buttons). The taskbar follows it; Patrone Settings also puts the theme's style for apps in the account's GTK settings. Where the taskbar's buttons go is the taskbar's own layout setting, which no theme changes.
